title: HeroSkills
description: The heroes' skills and the order to level them (Skill Upgrade Path page). Names and texts are localized as in pack_data.json; the heroes themselves (faction, class, portrait) are `heroes` in pack_data.json, referenced by id.

max_level.description: The highest skill level of a hero that isn't awakened; the guide's steps stop here.

foundation.description: The level every upgradable skill of every hero is raised to first, by the hero's class.

layout.description: Where the skills sit on a hero, as in the game: two columns, top to bottom.

awakening_caps.description: The skill cap of an awakened hero by awakening level: the entry with the highest `level` the hero reaches. Below the first entry the cap is `max_level`.

order.description: Per faction its heroes in the order of the priority steps (after the foundation).

foundation_order.description: Per faction its heroes in the order of the foundation steps (every skill to the foundation level). The same heroes as `order`, which is the order of the priority steps after the foundation.

tenacity.description: The 8-star skill every hero gets (Lv 1, not upgradable).

heroes.description: Per hero its skills, its path (the steps after the foundation) and a short note.

description.description: What the skill does. A {placeholder} is a number that depends on the skill's level: its name is a key of `values`.

values.description: The numbers of the description without any star bonus: per placeholder one list, the entry for level n at index n-1, null where the number isn't known yet (shown as ?); or one number for what doesn't depend on the level (a duration, a target count).

star_bonuses.description: The hero's star bonuses of this skill, by the star they unlock at. The page shows the skill as of a 10-star hero: all of them applied.

starBonus.description: A star bonus as the game words it. `scale` and `add` give a number's total change as of this star, from its base in `values` (a later bonus on the same number replaces an earlier one, "increases to 100%"); `description` is the skill's whole text from this star on (an added effect), replacing the earlier one.

text.description: The bonus, shown below the skill's description.

skill.description: Only in a weapon's bonuses: the skill it changes. A bonus without one is a plain stat buff (text only); one with it can also have `scale` / `add` / `description` once the numbers are known.

scale.description: Per placeholder the relative change in percent: base × (1 + n / 100).

add.description: Per placeholder the absolute change, added after `scale` (percentage points, seconds, targets).

description.description: The skill's whole text from this star on; its {placeholders} are keys of the skill's `values`.

awakeningSkill.description: The skill an awakening level unlocks, shown on that level's milestone on My Heroes (its icon, and its title and description in the tooltip): one of the hero's own skills (`skill`, its slot: its icon, and its name unless `name` gives the title the awakening shows) or a skill of its own (`id`, the icon's file name, and `name`).

level.description: The awakening level, one where the portrait's frame changes (AWAKENING_FRAMES in core/hero-stars.js).

name.description: The skill's title as the game shows it.

description.description: What the skill does, as the game words it (plain text).

weapon.description: The hero's exclusive weapon (0-10 stars): every star unlocks one bonus, four of them change a skill, the others are plain stat buffs.

bonuses.description: By the weapon star they unlock at, rising. The picture is webapp/public/assets/heroes/weapons/<hero id>.png.

step.description: A target, not an increment: the skills go to this level (each at least that, one that is further stays).

awakenable.description: The hero can be awakened: the page asks for the awakening level and shows the skill cap it gives.

damage_type.description: The damage all of the hero's skills deal: a hero is either fully energy or fully physical.

note.description: Why the path is as it is, in a few sentences.

skills.description: The four upgradable skills by slot.

awakening_skills.description: The skills the awakening levels unlock, by level, for an awakenable hero: the milestones of My Heroes show their icons (the hero's portrait where a level has none).

path.description: The steps after the foundation, in order. A skill no step names stays at the foundation level (e.g. a tank's auto attack).
